terrainEditor.webglUnavailable: The terrain cannot be displayed because WebGL2 is not available in this environment
terrainEditor.terrainTooLargeForGpu: The terrain grid ({{cols}}x{{rows}}) exceeds the GPU texture size limit ({{max}}) and cannot be displayed
terrainEditor.heightsLocked: This scenario contains built structures, so elevation, water surfaces, and rivers cannot be edited. The camera, ground cover, and climate can still be edited.

lockReason.PATHS_EXIST: Roads, railways, or other paths exist
lockReason.TERRAIN_MODIFIED: The terrain has been changed by grading or similar work

terrainEditor.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. They will be lost if you close this window without saving.
terrainEditor.editHint: Left-click to apply the selection once, left-drag to pan, right-click to confirm a polygon
terrainEditor.polygonHint: Click on the canvas to add vertices, then right-click or press "Complete Polygon" to close it. Then adjust the feather width and press "Confirm" to add to the selection (3 or more required)
terrainEditor.autoHint: If a selection exists, erosion starts from it (raindrop count is auto-scaled to the selected area); otherwise it applies to the entire map. The editor may freeze for a few seconds while running
terrainEditor.seaFloorNoTarget: No cells qualified as sea. Adjust the sea threshold elevation
terrainEditor.seaFloorHint: Cells at or below the threshold elevation are treated as sea and deepened with the given slope away from the coastline (smoothly approaching the max depth). Intended for data where the sea is uniformly 0m (e.g. GSI DEM). If there are 0m areas you want to keep (such as lakes), select only the sea area first before running
terrainEditor.waterHint: In add-water mode, left-click to add water polygon vertices, right-click (or "Close Shape") to close the shape (3+ points). Left-drag to pan. After closing the shape, set the water level below and press "Confirm Water" to register it as one water body. The sea (elevation 0m) is represented automatically; here you add only non-sea water bodies such as lakes.
terrainEditor.waterShapeClosed: Shape closed. Set the water level and press "Confirm Water".
terrainEditor.cameraHint: The camera position and direction used when this scenario starts. Left-click to place the camera, right-click to set the look-at point (direction). Left-drag pans the view. If left unset, the game starts with the default view at the map center (origin).
terrainEditor.cameraUnset: Not set. Left-click the canvas to place the camera.
terrainEditor.rainAreaHint: If a selection exists, rain falls only within it (rivers originating there flow all the way to the sea). Without a selection, rain falls on the whole map. Draw the area with the same tools as the Terrain tab (left-click for brush/polygon selection, right-click to close a polygon).
terrainEditor.riverHint: Automatically traces river courses from the terrain. "Compute Courses" does not modify the terrain. If there are too many or too few rivers, adjust the rainfall or minimum discharge and recompute.
terrainEditor.riverComputeHint: Computed courses are added to the list below as "not carved" (the terrain is not modified yet). Delete unwanted rivers or adjust each river's depth coefficient in the list, then carve them into the terrain one by one with "Carve". Recomputing replaces only the uncarved rivers.
terrainEditor.riverZeroHint: The maximum discharge on this map is {{maxQ}} m³/s, below the minimum discharge of {{minQ}} m³/s. Lower the minimum discharge or increase the rainfall.
terrainEditor.riverZeroShortHint: Some stretches exceed the minimum discharge, but they were too short to form rivers ({{discarded}} discarded). Lowering the minimum discharge further extends the channels upstream so they can qualify.
terrainEditor.riverDeleteHint: Deleting removes only the river data (water surface / saved data); the carved terrain is not restored. Use Ctrl+Z to restore the terrain as well.
terrainEditor.riverRecomputePolygonHint: Re-extracts the extent of every carved river (the area below the water surface) from the current terrain. Use after editing the banks by hand
terrainEditor.riverPreviewToggle: Carve preview (show uncarved rivers at their current depth)
terrainEditor.riverWaterToggle: Show water surface (off: inspect the river bed)
terrainEditor.riverSelectHint: Click a row to highlight the river with the same number on the map. Changing the depth coefficient updates the preview; "Confirm and carve" writes it into the terrain
terrainEditor.riverModeRainHint: Select an area with the same controls as terrain editing (rain area for auto-generation). Choose "Draw River" to place a river anywhere, or "Edit Nodes" to reshape an existing course
terrainEditor.riverDrawHint: Left-click to place vertices from upstream to downstream, right-click to confirm the river (2 or more points; Esc to start over). The course is a smooth curve through the vertices. If the end lies on the sea, a lake, or another river, it connects there. After confirming you can refine the shape with "Edit Nodes"
terrainEditor.riverNodeHint: Drag a node of the selected river to move it, left-click on the course to add a node, right-click a node to delete it (at least 2 remain). Moving the end onto the sea, a lake, or another river connects it there. Click another uncarved river to switch the selection
terrainEditor.riverNodeNoTarget: Select a river in the list or click an uncarved river on the map (carved or loaded rivers cannot be node-edited; use Ctrl+Z to go back before carving)
terrainEditor.riverRouteHint: Keep both endpoints and find low terrain on either side of the current route. Available before carving only. Widths are guides; the channel widens and narrows with the terrain.

saveErrors.TERRAIN_LOCKED: Elevation, water surfaces, and rivers cannot be saved in a scenario with built structures.
saveErrors.TERRAIN_INVALID: The terrain data is invalid and cannot be saved.
saveErrors.TERRAIN_SIZE_MISMATCH: The map dimensions cannot be changed.
saveErrors.RESOURCE_VALIDATION_ERROR: Some resource areas are invalid (fewer than 3 vertices, too small, etc.), so the terrain cannot be saved.
saveErrors.PROP_VALIDATION_ERROR: Some props have invalid placement values, so the terrain cannot be saved.

property_edit.deleteConfirm: Really delete this entity? This cannot be undone.
